composition: Cliff gorge village above a small sandy cove · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the beach the camera looks up at Atrani wedged in its cliff gorge. Pastel houses stack in the center, the church with its tower and dome crowns the upper right, and a row of great arches runs along the base above the dark-sand beach. Cliffs rise on the left and behind, and the 08:12 morning sun lights the facades.
